Settings generation 4: the usage rows for Claude and Codex, bounds, fill without moving values, an older release ignoring them, every generation-dependent fixture updated, and the --usage-cap flags

The gate before a job record exists returning a UsageHold, reservation renewal and ledger accounting on every completion path with a crash-safe replay sweep, including _reattach after a lapse, the run loop that waits and re-enters the full boundary without consuming a step, usage_paused and usage_resumed run events, and exit code 17

The usage subcommand and manual-worker gate: --check, --wait with renewed admission, --reserve, --renew and --release (with --stream), role/model/repo/run context, independent provider caps, and durable usage-events.jsonl
Documentation and roadmap: runtime and commands guides, exit codes, ADR 0011, common problems, C8 complete with C8b, C8c, C7 and C5 follow-ups recorded, check_docs and the full suite green
